subject: financial_literacy
concept: Completing a full independent financial capstone plan covering budget, major decisions, goals, resilience, employment evaluation, and personal philosophy, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content, synthesizing the full K-12 financial literacy sequence — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student compiles their full capstone plan across all components built in this unit
exercise.abstract: Student completes an independent financial capstone plan: a realistic budget, a major decision analysis, multi-horizon goals, a resilience plan, a job offer evaluation, and a personal philosophy statement

assessment.mastery_threshold: capstone demonstrates all components cohering into one complete, realistic personal financial readiness plan
misconception_flags: completes individual components without connecting them into one coherent overall plan

interest_binding: full capstone scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
